'''Fanrix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He participated in the [[Invasion of Ossus]], during which he was killed.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=location|Ossus}}</ref>
